title: fix(plugin-detail, plugin-grid): a refusal-named fill-in row reads the record the change would leave
body:
Fixes #37270
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化:在阶段菜单、记录页保存、列表单元格弹出的补填弹窗里,服务端拒绝保存时临时补上的字段,下拉选项现在按这次改动后的记录判断显示;阶段菜单的纯确认框里不再出现没有可选项的补填行。
- 为什么做:补填弹窗选项判断的同族收尾,替上一张「失败原因下拉暂无可选项」的卡补上服务端临时点名字段这一条少见路径。
- 出错会怎样:只影响服务端点名前端没预料到的字段时那一行的可选项;改动只是给这一行带上同一份合并后的记录,可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes
Each host's `refusalField` builder now hands the row it adds the record the change would leave, the same merge the collector judges its own rows on (`collectRequiredWhenPromptFields`: stored record + change). `RequiredFieldsDialog` resolves every control against the first shown row's `record` plus the typed values; with no collected row shown, the refusal row was the only candidate and carried none, so its options were judged on the typed values alone.

- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/recordPathStageChange.tsx`: `moved = { ...record, [statusField]: stage.value }`, set on the refusal row. This is the host where the defect is user-visible: a stage that needs nothing opens the dialog with no collected row.
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/InlineEditSaveBar.tsx`: `drafted = { ...data, ...ask.draft }`, set on the refusal row.
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridRequiredPrompt.tsx`: `{ ...record, [columnKey]: value }`, set on the refusal row.

No new authoring surface, no spec change, no change in `ui/packages/fields`. Kanban passes no `refusalField`; the timesheet add-row dialog is out of scope (card).

Files to read first (by risk): `recordPathStageChange.tsx` (the merge must match the collector's: `statusField` over the stored record), `objectGridRequiredPrompt.tsx` (`record` is the row with lacking keys read in, not the bare row), `InlineEditSaveBar.tsx`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordStageMenu.refusalRowRecord-37270.test.tsx` — 1 passed; the added `channel` row shows "Negotiation option" and not "Lost option".

## Tests
One pin per host, each red without its host's line (ablation below):
- `RecordStageMenu.refusalRowRecord-37270.test.tsx` (behaviour): a move to a stage that needs nothing, refused naming a radio whose options gate on `record.stage`; the added row offers the option visible on the moved record, not the empty state, and keeps the other stage's option hidden.
- `InlineEditSaveBar.refusalRowRecord-37270.test.tsx` and `objectGridRequiredPrompt.refusalRowRecord-37270.test.tsx` (row shape): the row `refusalField` returns carries `{ ...stored, ...change }`. In these two hosts the dialog only opens with at least one collected row, which already carries the merged record, so the dialog's rendered options do not differ without the fix; the pin is on the row the host hands over.

## Acceptance notes
- Done-when 1 ("visibleWhen reads the record the write would leave, also when no collected field is shown"): measured in the stage-menu host, the only host whose dialog can show no collected row. In the inline Save and list cell hosts it already held through the collected row's record; this PR makes their refusal rows carry it themselves, so it no longer depends on row order.
- Done-when 2 ("one pin per host, red without the fix"): three pins, three ablations red.

## Verification
Local readings land in the os-dev-report comment on #37270 and are folded in here once the package run finishes.
